title: ModuleInstallService
responsibility: Install one capability foundation without replacing existing project source or invoking providers.

inputs.name: ModuleInstallService.add.root
inputs.description: Absolute project directory containing the package manifest and module metadata.

inputs.name: ModuleInstallService.add.id
inputs.description: Validated identity of the capability module to install or inspect.

outputs.name: ModuleInstallService.add
outputs.description: Relative paths actually created or updated by this operation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid definitions, incompatible project settings, unsafe paths or conflicting source files prevent the operation.
